Commercial notes: evaluating hosted first (low friction), then move to Dedicated if latency/costs look right. Interested in committed monthly capacity vs pay-as-you-go tradeoffs. Asked for 12- and 36-month pricing examples.

Internal Redwood notes: good fit for mid-market Dedicated offering.
